hero.lede: AI visual testing is visual testing where AI, not a raw pixel diff, decides which UI changes matter. SmartUI Visual AI compares each screenshot with its baseline, understands layout and context, flags real regressions such as moved buttons or broken text, and ignores anti-aliasing and rendering noise.

items.a: AI visual testing uses AI to decide which visual differences between a screenshot and its baseline matter to users, instead of flagging every changed pixel.

items.q: How is visual AI different from pixel diffing?
items.a: Pixel diffing flags any changed pixel. Visual AI understands layout and context, so it ignores rendering noise and flags real regressions.
No. Visual AI still compares against approved baselines; it changes how differences are judged.
